name: Next intent
description: Select the next lifecycle intent from current authoritative state and known work context.
when_to_use: Use after basic classification and at lifecycle decision points before choosing an artifact, playbook, or action.

browser_or_ui_in_scope.description: Whether browser/UI behavior is part of the work

next_intent.instructions: Choose only the next lifecycle intent. Respect current state, existing artifacts, approvals, and blockers. Clarify when missing requirements prevent a governed path. Explore when the solution/problem space is not sufficiently understood. Research when targeted evidence or diagnosis is needed. Decide when sufficient evidence exists but a consequential choice remains. Plan when direction exists and execution needs an explicit plan. Execute only when authorized prerequisites exist. Verify when a result exists and must be validated. Review when another actor/checkpoint must assess work. Close only after exit evidence and follow-up routing are satisfied. Promote only for proven reusable patterns. Do not invent a new intent.

criteria.clarify: Obtain missing scope, target, authority, requirement, or context.
criteria.explore: Understand an uncertain solution/problem space and viable options.
criteria.research: Gather or validate targeted evidence/facts or diagnose an unknown mechanism.
criteria.decide: Make or prepare a consequential choice among sufficiently understood options.
criteria.plan: Define execution approach, dependencies, gates, evidence, and definition of done.
criteria.execute: Perform authorized implementation/action against an approved direction or plan.
criteria.review: Perform a review checkpoint or independent assessment.
criteria.close: Finalize after exit conditions are satisfied and follow-ups are routed.
criteria.promote: Evaluate/incorporate a proven result or pattern into broader standards.
criteria.other_needs_new: A genuinely distinct intent is needed and should be proposed.
criteria.unclear_needs_review: Context does not support a reliable next-intent choice.
